name: Parameter Sliders (What-if)
summary: What-if sliders bound to report parameters (@wacc, @tgr …); every computed field using them recalculates and the charts update live.
summary_zh: 绑定报告参数（@wacc、@tgr 等）的假设分析滑块：拖动后所有引用该参数的计算字段实时重算，图表同步更新。
description_zh: 用于 DCF / LBO / 情景分析页面，让客户自己调整 WACC、永续增长率、退出倍数等假设。每个滑块显示格式化的当前值、相对基准值的变化（百分比参数以 bps 表示）、轨道上的基准刻度和一键还原；点击数值可直接输入精确值。参数默认取报告 manifest.params，可在 options.params 中覆盖标签、范围、步长与格式。options.computed 可向绑定数据集添加引用 @参数 的公式字段，options.preview 则在滑块下方渲染一个实时读数表（当前值及相对基准假设的变化：金额与倍数显示相对变化 %，基准为零或负数时显示 n.m.；百分比字段显示百分点 pp，变动小于 1 pp 时显示 bps，负数用括号），便于在单个区块中演示参数驱动的计算。
best_for: LBO exit multiple and leverage assumptions
Sticky top-bar assumptions in an interactive model
Live readout of formula fields driven by parameters
avoid_when: The audience needs a fixed, printed answer (use a sensitivity table)
More than ~6 parameters at once (split by page)

params.desc: [{name, label, min, max, step, format, default}] or ['wacc', ...]; merged with RK.data.manifest.params; null = every report parameter. Missing ranges are inferred from the base value; labels default to the param title, then a standard name (wacc -> WACC, tgr -> Terminal growth)

compact.desc: Single-row label · track · value layout (automatic inside .rk-topbar)

columns.desc: Slider columns in the stacked layout (null = auto-fit, min 220px each)

showRange.desc: Formatted min / max under each track

showDelta.desc: Change vs. base value next to the value (bps for % formats)

computed.desc: [{name, formula, title, format}] computed fields added to the bound dataset (formulas may use @params)

preview.desc: true or {fields, where, title, total, key, summary, changes} — live readout table of the bound dataset; live cells show the change vs. base parameters in the field's own unit: relative % for amounts and multiples (n.m. when the base is zero or negative), percentage points for % fields (bps when every move in the column is under 1 pp), plain bps for bps fields; negatives in parentheses; total = true | [fields]; key = the output column set in bold (default: last computed column); summary = [{name, label, field + agg | expr over earlier names, format, key, change}] headline outputs under the table (e.g. PV of terminal value, enterprise value); changes = {field: 'rel' | 'pp' | 'pts' | 'bps' | 'none'} overrides the automatic choice ('pts' = values already in percent units)

interactions: Drag or arrow keys (native range input, aria-valuetext formatted)
Click the value to type an exact number (9.25%, 9.25 or 0.0925)
Store writes throttled while dragging; every computed field using the parameter recalculates
Preview cells flash and show the change vs. base (% for amounts, pp / bps for rates)

samples.title: Re-rating what-if — upside in pp, not % of a %
